links.note: The magazine's weekly frequency - the rhythm of the serialised novel
Naming the serialised novel Kashi Yatre - 674 by name, with Karmaveera the magazine as distractor
Triveni as the novel's author - a fact 674's description states
The novel's language - 674 is the 'serialized Kannada novel'; 673 is the script she had to master, which is not what is asked
Varanasi as the city the old woman in the novel longs for - the plot of Kashi Yatre itself
What shocked the narrator - answered from her never having seen her grandmother cry, i.e. the narrator's own vantage
Why she never went to school - the education denied her in girlhood, which is why she is learning at sixty-two
The realisation that money cannot buy literacy and that independence comes from education - 681 word for word
The narrator mocking her age when she resolves to study - the age objection the lifelong-learning theme answers
Her reply of calm conviction that determination overcomes any obstacle - her resolve, so 676
Calling her to the puja room to acknowledge her as teacher - the reversed teacher-student bond
The elder touching a child's feet - the role reversal 675 is built on
Her justification that she honours a teacher, not a child - mutual respect inside the reversed bond
The gift is a copy of Triveni's Kashi Yatre - the novel the whole arc turns on
When she poured her heart out - the night she resolves to learn to read at sixty-two
Her regret at being illiterate - the missed education that the late learning repairs; 681 is the dependence it caused
The deadline of Saraswati Puja day - 676 is explicitly the resolve to learn within a set deadline
The festival on which the deadline fell - the same self-imposed deadline
The child laughing at the decision - the age prejudice the story overturns
The traits mocked are grey hair and spectacles, markers of age - again the age-no-bar theme
Hours spent doing homework - the effort behind the deadline, so 676 rather than the script concept
Called to the puja room - the setting of the teacher-honouring scene
Touching her feet - the gesture of the reversed bond
Why it is unusual - only youngsters touch elders' feet, so the reversal is the point
She pays respect to her teacher - the bond, stated as the answer
The reward is a copy of the novel - the Kashi Yatre thread closing
Kashi Yatre named as the book gifted, against Karmaveera and Triveni as distractors
She reads the title aloud - the actual act of reading Kannada script, which is the mastery 673 describes
Her homework routine of reading and reciting for hours - the sustained effort of 676; what she practised is 673's concern
The correct option is that firm determination and willpower conquer any learning obstacle - 676 verbatim, and it rejects the role-reversal option
Slow transport delaying Karmaveera - the serial's late arrival and the waiting it caused
The Wednesday routine of reading the latest episode aloud - the serialised novel's place in their week
The week away at a wedding - the absence that cut the grandmother off from the serial
Rubbing her hands over the pictures, helpless without a reader - the dependence 681 is about
Too proud and embarrassed to ask anyone else - dignity and self-reliance, not the age theme
Reading the next episode aloud each week to her grandmother - the serial-reading routine
Discussing the story with her friends at the temple - how the serial lived in her week
The wedding as the reason for leaving - the trigger for the missed episode
A week's absence - the length of the gap in the serial for the grandmother
She could not read because she was illiterate - the plain literacy fact behind the whole learning arc
Rubbing her hands over the pictures - the image of helpless dependence
The family was well-off, which is the point: money did not make her independent, literacy would
She felt helpless and dependent - 681's exact substance
Too embarrassed to ask - the dignity cost of dependence
The narrator shocked to find her in tears - the same first-person discovery as the other items on this scene
Her childhood: mother lost early, never went to school, education for women not valued - the schooling she missed
How she proved she had reached her goal - a sixty-two-year-old reading a novel, which is the thesis of 672; the script mechanics are 673's item
